description.value: Milk Jam Donuts is a small-batch artisan donut shop in downtown Nanaimo specializing in 24-hour-raised brioche donuts, filled cronuts, and house-made flavoured milks. Their glazes and fillings are crafted from real ingredients — fresh fruit, vanilla bean, organic cocoa — and coffee is brewed from locally roasted Drumroaster beans. Stock is limited and sells out regularly, so cyclists stopping by should check their @milkjamdonuts social feed before making a detour.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 83m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name and address (165 Commercial St, Nanaimo, BC) and shows an active online ordering cart with Square checkout, confirming the business is open and takeout-oriented. OSM tags corroborate fast_food/donut category, no drive-through, and the check_date of 2025-09-07 indicates a recent verification. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on the website.
Business operates only Wednesday–Saturday and sells out before closing time — cyclists should verify availability via social media before visiting, but this does not affect listing status.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open artisan donut and coffee shop on Commercial Street in Nanaimo; a useful refreshment stop for touring cyclists passing through.

wow_evidence: small-batch artisan donut shop… locally roasted Drumroaster beans
